text:
jamie_ops: Heads up — vendor just told us delayed H100 shipment for us-east1. We have a spike tomorrow morning and could use 3-4 H100 slots for ~4h. Can we reshuffle pools or borrow on-prem racks? Finance also flagged an invoice hold for vendor-123. Need a quick contingency plan.
maria_infra: On it. What timeframe exactly? How many slots and do we need full NVLink?
jamie_ops: Peak 09:00-12:00 UTC. 3-4 slots. Full NVLink preferred but we can accept mixed if needed.
li_yu: We can fall back to mixed A100+L40s but need to check model (quantization) for latency-sensitive paths. Which model and batch sizes?
jamie_ops: llama-3-130b int8, interactive inference at batch size 1 mostly. Perf hit acceptable up to ~30%.
michael_procure: @jamie_ops I see the invoice hold — finance needs PO number and vendor SLA PDF to release. @procurement_bot can you pull PO status?
procurement_bot: PO-789 status: pending approval from finance@redwood.com. Missing: vendor SLA (vendor-123/sla.pdf) and PO justification note.
maria_infra: If PO clears within 2h we can request a soft-standby from vendor. If not: plan A) swap 2 jobs to onprem rack 'rack-phi' (2 slots available, NVLink), plan B) route 1 job to us-west1 h100 on-demand or spot.
jamie_ops: rack-phi network egress ok? latency for interactive workloads?
maria_infra: rack-phi has NVLink and 10Gbps egress; fine for batch and near-interactive but might raise tail latency for heavy context windows.
li_yu: For interactive fallbacks, we can lower context window to 8k and enable faster decoding to keep p50 latency. That reduces quality a bit but it's acceptable for the next 4h.
jamie_ops: If we route to us-west1 what is the cost delta? cc @finance
finance_person: Finance: us-west1 H100 on-demand is about $420/hr/slot extra compared to reserved. For a 3-slot 3-hour window that's ~ $3.8k incremental. We can approve short-term charge if infra confirms necessary before 08:00 UTC.
jamie_ops: Action items then: 1) @michael_procure escalate PO with vendor SLA to unblock standby; 2) @maria_infra prepare onprem swap playbook for rack-phi; 3) @li_yu prepare PR to reduce context window + enable int8 speedups; 4) I will confirm final routing by 07:45 UTC.
michael_procure: Escalating now, pinging vendor ops and finance slack thread. :thumbsup: 
li_yu: PR ready draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1429 — includes feature flag `canary_low_context` and quantize fallback toggle.
maria_infra: Creating temp routing policy and TF snippet:
```
route_policy:
  preferred: us-east1
  fallbacks:
    - onprem: rack-phi
    - region: us-west1
```
I'll also start the onprem prep checklist (nvlink check, container image sync).
deploy-bot: Canary job scheduled by jamie_ops at 07:45 UTC in namespace infra-canary. ID: cb-9012.
jamie_ops: Thanks all — I'll reconfirm by 07:30 UTC after procurement update. If PO still blocked we'll execute onprem+us-west1 mix. :white_check_mark: 
procurement_bot: Noted: vendor SLA uploaded to PO-789 by vendor-ops@thirdparty.com at 06:22 UTC. Awaiting final finance approval.
finance_person: We approved PO-789 at 06:40 UTC. Procurement, you can request standby.
michael_procure: Standby requested to vendor-123, ETA for standby allocation ~45m. Will update in this thread when confirmed.
maria_infra: Great. I'll keep rack-phi warm and start syncing images. If vendor standby arrives we will pivot to vendor pool and cancel onprem allocation.
jamie_ops: Perfect — appreciate the quick turnaround. I'll post a short status to #incidents if anything changes.
